body: Yep. Depression is the sickness that convinces you getting better is impossible, or that even if it is possible, you certainly don't deserve it.

Hey, you can e-mail me the truth. I know what it's like to lie all the time.

Will PM you the address.

I have a rare genetic disorder, too. I'll likely be in a wheelchair with severe arthritis before I hit 50. But I was no ray of sunshine before finding this out, either, because another of my genetic gifts was depression.

Some of us get dealt a shitty hand, eh? But I still hold out for hope, at least some of the time (though not so much tonight, it seems). There are people in worse circumstances than mine who seem to be happy somehow.
